items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions King Oliver and Clyde, and the interviewer mentions Louis Armstrong in relation to King Oliver, but the interviewee does not mention Louis Armstrong directly or describe a personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yes, that's what I'm trying to get around to. Yes, Clyde played with King Oliver, you know. Because he used to tell me a lot of different things about when he was with King Oliver, and also when he was with Edgar Hayes and --
That was after Louis was with King Oliver. That was in the latter period.
Uh-huh, yes, that's true. So Clyde tickled me, though, because at one time we did -- I think it was 90 straight one-nighters.
